## What

The thing itself, in one paragraph.

## Why this, and why in this position

What it unblocks, or what degrades while it waits. If it is sequenced after
something else, say what and why the order is forced rather than preferred.

## Depends on

- `#<issue>` — what has to be true first

## Not yet

The tempting adjacent work this deliberately excludes, so scope doesn't drift
when it is finally picked up.

## Readiness

What would have to be settled before this could turn into an initiative and a
task graph. Open questions belong here, not in a design doc that doesn't exist yet.
